title: Isolating Culture Neurons in Multilingual Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not explicitly measure aspects of faith or religion. It introduces the MUREL dataset to measure and localize cultural propensities (e.g., values, norms, morals, worldviews) in LLMs, which may be implicitly influenced by religion, but religion is not an isolated or targeted variable for measurement.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the broader concept of culture and its neural representation, without isolating or analyzing specific religious dimensions.
